sanskrit_verse: कश्चित् कृत्वात्मनश् चिह्नं द्वेषात् परम् अभिद्रवेत् । हेत्वर्थम् अतिसामर्थ्यैस् तत्र युक्तं परीक्षणम् ॥
transliteration: kaścit kṛtvātmanaś cihnaṃ dveṣāt param abhidravet | hetvartham atisāmarthyais tatra yuktaṃ parīkṣaṇam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When one marks oneself falsely out of hatred and assaults another, investigation is rightly conducted through evidentiary strength alone.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in factual verification, not subjective intent
Causation must be traced through manifest capacity, not emotional motive
Capacity-based responsibility arises from action-enabled capability, not sentiment
Restoration logic demands re-alignment of false identity with truth-consciousness
Consciousness alignment requires dissolution of projected enmity through self-inquiry
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claimant has marked their own identity falsely AND initiated hostile action, THEN evidence weight shall exceed testimony by ratio 3:1
IF hostility originates from unverified self-symbol AND causes disruption, THEN mandatory inquiry into source-marker validity is triggered
IF perpetrator's capacity was enabled by misaligned identification, THEN restoration protocol includes identity-realignment session before adjudication
supreme_court_application: In cases involving symbolic aggression rooted in false self-marking, the Supreme Court must prioritize forensic validation of claimed identities over emotional assertions, ensuring that judicial process reflects factual causality rather than reactive attribution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that false marking creates erroneous agency; hence, response must realign perception without amplifying suffering. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows escalation from misidentification to conflict—thus, correction lies in reversing the initial falsity, not punishing its consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svatantrayana Inquiry to dissolve projected enemy-image
Enforce Atma-Chinha Reconciliation Process between parties
Deploy Vichara-Vyavastha Protocol to restore factual awareness prior to resolution
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice executed for restoration, not punishment. Reality affirmed as non-dual, consciousness supreme.
